verdict.rationale: Docusign offers configurable workflows, reusable templates, conditional CLM rules, and a REST API/MCP connector that can trigger workflow actions programmatically (docusign-docs-4, docusign-docs-40, docusign-docs-12, docusign-docs-21), which could be used to build automations. However, there is no explicit documentation of persistent, autonomous background agents or scheduled/triggered automations running without human intervention. Missing for 10: dedicated autonomous-agent/scheduler feature, evidence of unattended background execution, and independent confirmation of such automations working reliably.
